text:
lena_sm: Heads up — we have a partial degradation impacting embeddings ingestion for ~18 EU tenants (mostly onboarding flows). SRE says it's a KV-caching regression, not a model quality issue. Need coordinated customer comms + translations.

maria_cs: Thanks. Can someone drop the definitive affected-tenant list here? I want to start triaging renewal-risk flags and personalized outreach.

aj_eng: Pushed the short postmortem notes to the incident page: https://intra.redwood/incident/45780 — root cause: cache eviction bug after last runtime roll (kernel selector). Fix merged, rolling restart in progress. ETA for full recovery ~35–45m.

kevin_support: Great. CS asks: will customers see 5xx errors or degraded embeddings quality? Need wording for proactive email + in-console banner. Also check which accounts are on renewals in next 60 days.

aj_eng: They'll see increased 503s for ingestion jobs and some delayed vectors; no change to generation/chat. No model drift. We have an automatic fallback to cold-cache with higher latency which is on for a subset — that's why only some tenants hit errors.

maria_cs: Understood. Drafting two short templates: 1) High-touch (renewal risk, pay customers) 2) Bulk notice for trials. Posting draft in thread for review.

maria_cs: "Hi <Account Owner>, we experienced a partial ingestion disruption affecting vector uploads in EU between <start> and <ETA>. Teams are restoring service; immediate mitigation is in place. No model outputs were altered. We're offering 1x credit + optional office hours for sensitive integrations. Will follow up with RCA and timeline. — Redwood CS"

lena_sm: Good. Add personalization tokens: "example job ids", "last successful upload" and a one-click link to schedule office hours. Keep first message <100 words.

ivy_l10n: I'll handle translations (FR/DE/ES/JA). Suggest short subject lines per locale and a 1–2 sentence banner translation for the console. I can turn drafts around in ~2 hours once copy is final.

kevin_support: For the in-console banner: propose: "Partial vector ingestion degradation in EU — we are mitigating. Some uploads may fail or be delayed. Contact Support or schedule office hours." Keep <120 chars.

maria_cs: Teams, confirm who will own: (1) sending high-touch emails, (2) attaching per-account credit, (3) scheduling office hours. I can own (1) + coordinate personalization if I get the tenant list.

lena_sm: I'll own (2) — will queue credits for affected tenants and note renewal flags. @aj_eng please confirm when restart completes so we can update customers.

aj_eng: Restart finished for primary EU pool at +28m; metrics show request rate normalizing. I'll post final recovery timestamp and a short RCA summary in 10m.

ops-bot: incident-45780 status change: RESOLVED -> PARTIALLY_RESOLVED. See: https://intra.redwood/incident/45780/logs

maria_cs: Thanks — plan: send high-touch emails in phased batches (priority renewals first) w/ localized copy from @ivy_l10n. Follow-up with full RCA once aj_eng posts the summary. I'll tag renewal owners and update Zendesk tickets.

lena_sm: Also flag the cohort in Gainsight for post-incident outreach and capture NPS/feedback in the office hours. Good catch on localization — that's important for EU renewals.

kevin_support: I'll prepare the support playbook + canned responses in Zendesk macros. Add macro: "offer-office-hours" with scheduling link + credit confirmation.

maria_cs: One more ask — please capture a short FAQ snippet about "Was customer data affected?" (answer: no). We should include it in all comms.

aj_eng: FAQ draft: "No customer data was exposed or altered. The issue affected the caching layer for vector ingestion only; stored vectors are intact. We are issuing credits for failed ingestion jobs where applicable."

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll stitch everything together and post the send plan + localized subjects in ~30m. Thanks team. :heart:
